note: Public instructional subset only. No private HTML/API/user data.

articles.title: Notes, folders, and Library filters
articles.summary: Write notes, organize folders, and filter without moving items unintentionally.
steps: Tap Create → Note. Status shows Unsaved, Saved on this device, Waiting to sync, Synchronized, or Failed — retry.
Empty titles become Untitled after save. Reopen the same note from Library or Search.
Library uses one workspace folder tree (depth up to five). Filters change the view only — Clear filters never moves items.
Folder moves keep the same ID, dates, and links. Trash/restore keeps recovery rules.
articles.expectedResult: Notes reopen with the same identity; filters do not rearrange storage.

articles.title: Search coverage and limits
articles.summary: Search stays inside your workspace; offline search only covers locally stored records.
steps: Open Search from the shell.
Results stay inside your authorized workspace. Vault items stay out of ordinary search.
Offline, search only covers records already on this device — coverage is not claimed as complete.
articles.expectedResult: You see honest results or an empty state; Help search never queries private notes for instructional lookup.

articles.title: Local save, sync, and conflicts
articles.summary: Saved on this device is not the same as server acknowledgment. Resolve conflicts explicitly.
steps: Edit as usual. Watch status: Unsaved → Saved on this device → Waiting to sync → Synchronized (or Failed — retry).
Pending mutations stay queued offline and retry with the same operation ID when online.
If Conflict appears, open conflict review. Keep both versions recoverable — never rely on client clock as winner.
articles.expectedResult: You can explain each status; long text is never silently replaced.

articles.title: Trusted-device offline and updates
articles.summary: Distinguish warm offline use, local browser shell evidence, and installed-PWA/native verification still outstanding.
steps: While already open, edits queue offline and show honest unavailable states for remote-only features.
Trusted-device consent is required for durable browser storage. Missing consent or storage shows a truthful offline help page.
When an app update is ready: save work, then Update — or choose Later. Update will not activate while unsaved work remains.

Cold reopen: a public offline shell can restore local IndexedDB records on a trusted device. Installed production PWA and native installed-build cold launch verification may still be outstanding — do not treat engineering fixtures as a platform guarantee.
articles.expectedResult: You understand local vs cloud and Update/Later without losing drafts.

failures.recovery: Grant trusted-device consent online once, ensure local data exists, then retry. Or reconnect.
Follow recovery limits; never expect plaintext fallbacks for native encryption failures.

articles.title: Export, import, and Trash
articles.summary: Move data with validation; Trash restore and deletion limits stay explicit.
steps: Open Settings / recovery or portability surfaces for Export.
Import only trusted files; invalid imports are rejected with validation errors.
Trash restore brings back eligible items; offline edits against deleted records stay recoverable drafts, not silent resurrection.
articles.expectedResult: Exports are workspace-scoped; Help never runs a destructive export/delete by being opened.

articles.title: Search Help and Learn the app
articles.summary: Find articles, open Learn the app chapters, and replay the beginner guide without losing drafts.
steps: Open Help. Use Search how-to for instructional content only.
Browse categories or Common tasks. Open an article for steps and recovery.
Use Learn the app for chapter links. Replay beginner guide from Help when offered — it does not reset settings.
Contextual Help from editors opens the article without discarding unsaved text.
articles.expectedResult: You can find guidance offline for essential recovery articles without live AI.
